title: Documentation (--docs) mode not running in local development
body:
**Describe the bug**
According to [Storybook Docs](https://storybook.js.org/docs/react/writing-docs/build-documentation#preview-storybooks-documentation) running `start-storybook --docs` should run a local instance in documentation mode, where the navigation is flattened and the toolbar is removed... similarly to how a public docs would be distributed. However running `start-storybook --docs` appears to run a local instance of Storybook in a normal mode where the navigation is not flattened, and the toolbar is present.

**To Reproduce**

1. In Terminal, run `yarn start-storybook --docs`
2. When everything is compiled, open storybook instance in browser
3. Be sad because its not in docs mode ☹️ 

I've also tried this with a fresh, unedited storybook install, and the results are the same.

**Expected behavior**
I expect that running `start-storybook --docs` to run a local instance of storybook in documentation mode [as described](https://storybook.js.org/docs/react/writing-docs/build-documentation#preview-storybooks-documentation) (flattened navigation and no toolbar).

**Additional context**
I also asked about this in the [Design Systems Slack workspace](https://design-systems.slack.com/archives/CDTMWTTDY/p1614794353024000) (which I realize isn't an official channel for communicating about Storybook). The answer received made it sound like running Storybook in documentation mode isn't intended - in which case the docs I referenced above are severely misleading.
